name: feature-delivery
invariants: No write-capable node is reachable before the current brief is approved: user_explicitly_approved, or auto_approved_by_policy when .ai-harness/harness.json sets approval to auto and the brief records its choices as decisions with nothing left in needs_human or open_questions.
A blocking finding cannot transition directly to done.
Every repair is followed by required checks and re-review.
publish commits, pushes, and opens a PR only as .ai-harness/harness.json git_policy allows; it never merges, force-pushes, or pushes to the base branch.

Work that was pushed is not done until remote CI for the pushed commit has finished green or the repository has no remote CI; local runs of the CI commands do not stand in for it, a failure goes back through repair, and remote CI that cannot be observed ends as unverified, never as done.

Only the merge node merges, and only when .ai-harness/harness.json git_policy is merge and the run is not unattended: the driver reads the pull request from its host and merges with the head pinned to the pushed, reviewed commit after remote CI passed, only when every condition in merge_policy.require holds; an unmet condition waits (resume checks again) and a blocked one goes to user_decision, never bypassed.

Merged work is not done until every check in merge_policy.verify passed for the merge commit (target_ci, then deploy_check_cmd, then smoke_cmd); a failure or a result that cannot be observed ends at user_decision with rollback instructions, never as done, and the driver never reverts on its own.
The delivery node follows the project test policy: TDD, required, recommended, or no automated-test requirement.

A change with ui_scenarios is not done until ui_review has rendered and operated them in a browser with no blocking UI finding; ui_review follows the project ui-review contract, does not change the working tree, and a UI that could not be verified ends at user_decision as unverified, never as done.
